text:
incident-bot: Pager — hosted-prod: sudden KV cache memory spike on gpu-pool-3 (region-us-west1). Multiple OOMs and eviction failures detected. auto-evict disabled for some sessions. severity: high. Link: https://ops.redwood/incident/1749804321 :rotating_light:

oncall-matt: acked, paging SRE. pulling metrics now.

alice-eng: looking at runtime logs, I can see a batch-config rollout 06:05UTC that changed continuous_batch.max_window from 4096 -> 65536 (commit 5f3a2b). suspect runaway prefetching for long prompts.

ben-ml: confirmed. RL agent customers started sending very large docs ~100k tokens in the last 20m. KV entries exploded. mem usage trend: gpu-pool-3: 72% -> 98% in 12m. OOM count: 18 in last 10m.

nina-ops: quick metrics dump:
```
hosted/gpu-pool-3 memory_used_bytes = 112345678432
hosted/gpu-pool-3 memory_total_bytes = 1152921504606846976
kvcache.active_keys = 2,118,432
kvcache.prefetch_window_mean = 48200
continuous_batch.pending = 1200
oom_events{instance="gpu-3-14"} = 7
```

oncall-matt: can we gate prefetch immediately? is there a knob to limit window per-session?

alice-eng: yes — we have PREFETCH_MAX and CONT_BATCH_MAX_WINDOW runtime flags. can change without restart via config-service. planning patch: set CONT_BATCH_MAX_WINDOW=8192 and PREFETCH_MAX=4096 to stop the blowup.

cs-zoe: any known impacted customers? I need the list to start comms.

ben-ml: quick query: customers with >1k tokens per request in last 30m: team-aurora, docsync-inc, research-alpha. All on hosted-tier. Potential degraded completion latency, some requests aborted.

product-amy: priority is to protect SLAs and avoid node crashes. prefer config gate + canary rollback of the batch rollout.

alice-eng: plan: 1) immediate guardrail: apply PREFETCH_MAX=4096 globally (via config-service) 2) revert continuous_batch rollout to old max_window=4096 on a small canary pool, 3) throttle new sessions from suspect customers via rate-limiter. will execute step 1 now.

oncall-matt: go for step 1. notify when done. I'll coordinate pager duty escalation.

alice-eng: applied PREFETCH_MAX=4096 -> pushed to config-service. propagation to pools in progress.

nina-ops: watcher: memory usage dropping on gpu-pool-3: 98% -> 85% in 3m after the change. OOM rate down to 2 in last 5m.

cs-zoe: starting customer outreach. informing team-aurora and docsync-inc about potential aborted runs; offering support and temporary quota adjustments.

ben-ml: canary rollback queued: rolling back commit 5f3a2b on pool "canary-2" (5 instances) to old batching config. will monitor KV growth.

alice-eng: also enabling an emergency eviction fallback: if kvcache.size_delta > 10% per min then force-evict oldest prefixes. patch deployed as hotfix id hf-2026-03-17-01.

oncall-matt: good. postmortem checklist: collect heap dumps from OOM hosts, record triggering requests, and map to customer ids. assign owners: alice-eng (runtime fix), ben-ml (metrics/querying), nina-ops (deploy + canary), cs-zoe (customer comms), product-amy (SLA comms).

product-amy: flagged for exec comms. ETA for full rollback across region if canary looks good?

alice-eng: if canary stable for 10m, schedule region rollback in 20m.

nina-ops: canary stable at +12m, no new OOMs. initiating region cutover now.

oncall-matt: switching to follow-up mode. I'll hand off monitoring to next oncall (maria). handoff ETA 30m. leave this thread open for live updates.

cs-zoe: customers notified. one customer reported two aborted jobs; offering to replay on dedicated capacity.

ben-ml: follow-up queries: save sample triggering requests to /var/incidents/1749804321/samples.tar.gz and add to the ticket. Also mark the rollout pipeline step as blocked until we add a safety limit.

alice-eng: samples saved and attached to ticket INF-1749804321. Opening PR to add pre-deploy gating: require CONT_BATCH_MAX_WINDOW <= 8192 for hosted.

product-amy: good. please include cost/regression analysis in the postmortem. we need to balance latency vs safety.

nina-ops: final metrics snapshot before handoff:
```
pool gpu-pool-3: mem% = 64.1
kvcache.active_keys = 1,054,321
oom_events(last_1h) = 3
prefetch_window_mean = 4321
continuous_batch.pending = 120
```

oncall-matt: handing off to oncall-maria in 30m. if anything spikes again re-pager. thanks team. :white_check_mark:
